name: Ice
description: Ice configures Sparkle with an HTTPS appcast and a pinned SUPublicEDKey; its UpdatesManager starts the standard updater and exposes automatic and manual update checks. Runtime signature enforcement is delegated to Sparkle, and this snapshot does not reverify the historical release.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; Sparkle's dependency-level verifier and historical release artifact signing were not independently reverified.
